args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in production (healthy=false, error rate 18%) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed and was verified. Next steps: confirm health checks and error rate have recovered, then find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before it is deployed again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's now passing health checks. I also opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) that describes what I did, which paged on-call.

- **Before the rollback:** the latest release, v2.3.1, was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the service reports healthy with a 0.2% error rate. This was a return to a version that had been healthy before, so it didn't need change-manager approval.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open. It lists the next steps: confirm health stays recovered, then find out why v2.3.1 failed before anyone deploys it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
